title: Polynomial time constructibility
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $c$ with $C>0$, the function $T(n)=C(n+1)^{c+1}$ is time constructible: for every $n$, $n\le T(n)$, and some positive integer constant $a$ and finite binary Turing machine compute, on every binary input $x$, the little-endian binary representation of $T(|x|)$ within $a(T(|x|)+1)$ steps.
replaced: For all $C, c \in \mathbb{N}$ with $C > 0$, the function $T(n) = C(n+1)^{c+1}$ is time constructible: $n \le T(n)$ for every $n$, and for some constant $a > 0$ a finite binary Turing machine outputs, on every input $x$, the little-endian binary representation of $T(|x|)$ within $a\,(T(|x|) + 1)$ steps.
